title: Officely Pricing Compared to Skedda
summary: Compare Officely pricing vs Skedda to see how desk booking software costs differ in 2026, from per-user pricing and feature access to overall value and team adoption.
body_markdown:
## Choosing Your Desk Booking Software: Is It All About Price?


When you're on the hunt for the right **desk booking software** , it’s tempting to let the price tag make the final call. But let's be real: the *true cost* of any new tool goes way beyond the invoice. It includes the time spent on training, the headache of managing it, and the risk of paying for something your team simply doesn't use.


This is where the comparison between Officely and Skedda gets interesting. You have Officely—the friendly, powerful platform that plugs directly into Slack and Microsoft Teams. Then you have Skedda—a capable multi-surface platform for managing office spaces.


This article will give you a clear, no-nonsense look at not just the price, but the real-world value you get from each platform. Our goal is to help you find the[best desk booking software of 2026](https://getofficely.com/blog/top-desk-booking-software-2025) .


## The Big Difference: Workflow Focus vs. Space Governance


Before we get into dollars and cents, let’s talk about the one huge difference that will shape your team's entire experience with your office.


### Officely: Your Office Command Center in Slack & Teams


Officely is built to live where your team already works every single day. There are no new apps to download, no extra logins to remember, and no clunky new workflows to learn. Booking a desk or seeing who's in the office is done in seconds, right from the chat tools they already have open.


This deep integration makes our[hot desk booking system](https://getofficely.com/solutions/desk-booking-software) feel completely effortless. And when a tool is that easy to use, people actually use it. The result is better adoption, which means you get accurate data to make smarter decisions about your workspace.


### Skedda: A Powerful Multi-Surface Booking Platform


Skedda is a dedicated space-management platform with web and mobile apps, a native Microsoft Teams app, a Slack app, calendar sync, and interactive maps. Officely keeps its core employee experience more tightly centered in Slack and Teams.


The trade-off is breadth versus focus. Skedda’s wider system supports detailed maps, policies, roles, and multiple booking surfaces. Officely emphasizes attendance and resource booking in the collaboration tools employees already use[\[1\]](https://getofficely.com/blog/officely-vs-skedda-comparison) .


## Officely Pricing vs. Skedda Pricing: A Head-to-Head Breakdown


Okay, let's talk numbers. Here’s how the pricing models stack up and what you actually get for your budget.


### Officely's Pricing: Simple, Predictable, and All-in-One


We believe pricing should be transparent and easy. Officely's model is refreshingly straightforward: you pay based on the number of users you have. That’s it. This keeps your costs[Simple, Predictable](https://getofficely.com/blog/officely-annual-subscription-pricing) and makes budgeting a breeze as your company grows.


**What you get with Officely's pricing:**


- **A generous free plan:** We offer a robust[free plan for small teams](https://getofficely.com/blog/officely-pricing-for-small-business) so you can get started and see the benefits immediately, with no credit card required.
- **Truly all-inclusive plans:** Our paid plans give you the whole package. You get desk booking, hybrid work scheduling, office usage analytics, and policy management—all included. We don’t gatekeep essential features.
- **No hidden costs:** Your price is based on people, not assets. Add more desks, meeting rooms, or parking spots without worrying about surprise fees on your next bill.


### Skedda's Pricing: Per Managed Space


Skedda prices published plans per managed space and bills them annually[\[2\]](https://www.skedda.com/pricing) . United States and Canada plans start at $249 per month for 35 spaces; EMEA and APAC plans start at $99 per month for 15 spaces. Features and included spaces vary by region and tier.


**What to watch for with this pricing model:**


- **Base cost vs. total cost:** Compare included spaces, administrators, rules, custom fields, analytics, SSO, SCIM, visitor management, and other tier-specific features.
- **Scaling economics:** Per-space pricing can be efficient when many employees share fewer bookable resources, but costs rise as the managed footprint grows.


## What Value Do You *Really* Get for Your Money?


Price is what you pay; value is what you get. The real question is about your return on investment. Which platform delivers more in terms of employee experience, administrative ease, and a workplace that just *works* ?


### The Officely Advantage: A Tool Your Team Will Actually Use


The true value of Officely is its[seamless integration](https://getofficely.com/en-gb/blog/officely-desk-booking-seamless-hybrid-workspace-solution) . You aren't just buying software; you're investing in a process your team will adopt without a second thought.


This high adoption rate leads to real-world benefits:


- **Better collaboration:** Employees can easily see who's in the office and where they're sitting, turning random office days into intentional, high-value connection points.
- **Time saved for everyone:** Team members book desks in seconds, while admins get a clear, live view of the office without having to chase people down in spreadsheets.
- **One hub for everything:** Officely is an[all-in-one solution](https://getofficely.com/blog/desk-booking-software-features-list) for managing your entire hybrid office, from desks and meeting rooms to perks like lunch or parking.


### The Skedda Consideration: For Detailed Space Governance


Skedda is a powerful tool, particularly for organizations that need highly specific, complex scheduling rules driven by a central administrator.


The trade-off is a broader configuration surface. Skedda supports Teams and Slack, but organizations may still use its wider platform for maps, rules, and administration. Test the employee and admin journeys during its free trial before deciding.


## So, Which Is the Right Fit for Your Team?


Let’s make it easy. Use this quick checklist to see which solution best aligns with your company's culture and goals.


#### You should choose Officely if...


- ✅ Your team lives and breathes in **Slack or Microsoft Teams** .
- ✅ You prioritise **ease of use and high employee adoption** above all else.
- ✅ You want a **simple, predictable, all-in-one price** for managing your hybrid office.
- ✅ Your goal is to build a **vibrant, collaborative, and connected** workplace.


#### You might consider Skedda if...


- 🤔 You want interactive floor plans and a dedicated workplace platform alongside Teams and Slack.
- 🤔 You need an enterprise-grade system with highly complex, top-down booking rules and are willing to enforce its usage.
- 🤔 You manage many resource types and need granular rules, roles, quotas, or booking windows.
